'''Vindi's shuttle'''<ref name="Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> was a ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle was owned by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> It was later captured during a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory]], in which [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to transport Vindi to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], for trial.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />
